raw_text: New Rohingya refugee crisis brewing. Myanmar military and Arakan Army clashing again in Rakhine, pushing refugees toward Bangladesh. BGB firing warning shots at the border. Cox's Bazar already has over a million Rohingya. Bangladesh can't take more. India should be worried about secondary flows into Tripura and Mizoram too.
